scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Yes, this is Deepa speaking. Who is this?

I'm the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. It's about an important matter regarding your account. For your privacy, I just need to confirm it's you before I share any details. Could you tell me the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Thank you, Deepa. Your personal loan EMI of nine thousand five hundred rupees is due on the twentieth of October, and it is currently fourteen days overdue. As per your loan terms, a late payment charge of five hundred rupees has been added. Would you be able to clear it today? I can send you a secure payment link on SMS or WhatsApp.
I... I'm really sorry, I can't pay right now. I lost my job recently, and I just don't have the money this month. Is there any way the EMI or the late fee can be reduced or delayed?
I hear you. I'm really sorry to hear that, Deepa, and thank you for telling me. Is this something short-term, or hard to say right now?
It's hard to say right now. I lost my job a few weeks ago and I'm still searching, so I honestly don't know when things will get better.

I noted that you lost your job a few weeks ago and you're still searching, so you don't know when things will improve. I can't change the amount or charges myself, but I have noted it for our team. Our internal team will check this and arrange a call back for you. Is this number the best one to reach you on?
Yes, this number is fine. But can you tell me if the late fee can be waived or the EMI deferred? I don't want to just wait for a call with no answer.
I understand. I have noted that you asked about waiving the late fee and deferring the EMI. Thank you for talking with me, Deepa. Have a good day.

result.message: Special situation (hardship), step 1 of 3, from the call system. In one sentence, say warmly, in their own terms, that you are really sorry to hear it and thank them for telling you. Then, only if they have not already said how long it may last or when they might manage, gently ask whether it is something short-term or hard to say right now. Say nothing after the question. Do not mention the amount, the late fee or paying. Say only this step, in at most four short sentences, in the borrower's language. If they asked for a waiver, a lower amount, more time or a fee removal, say kindly that you can't change that yourself and that you have noted it for the team. If they asked something you have no detail for (how or when a loan was made, when exactly the team will call), say honestly that you don't have that detail and the team will check it. Never promise when the call back will come, a waiver or any change. Never ask "Is there anything else?".

args.notes: Borrower lost job a few weeks ago, still searching, cannot pay now. Asked for late fee waiver and EMI deferral. Number confirmed as best contact.

result.message: Recorded. Now speak, in the borrower's language, unless you already said it this turn: First answer what they just said, in one or two short sentences: if they asked for something (a real person to call, a call back soon, no surprise charges, a time that suits them), say you have noted it and name what they asked, in their own words; if they said they won't pay until it is sorted, say you understand. Then close once with thanks ("Thank you for talking with me, <name>. Have a good day."; in Hindi "बात करने के लिए धन्यवाद, <name> जी। आपका दिन शुभ हो।"). Do not repeat what you already said in the call.

outcome.notes: Borrower lost job a few weeks ago, still searching, cannot pay now. Asked for late fee waiver and EMI deferral. Number confirmed as best contact.
